note: Authored demonstrations, not benchmark examples. Text descriptions are for the reader; the models consume only prior, reliability, and signal.

ordinary.description: An ordinary positive reading from a useful sensor.

weak.description: A positive reading from a sensor only slightly better than a coin flip.

reversed.description: The sensor is usually wrong. Its positive reading is evidence against the event.

rare.description: A reliable positive reading about an event that was initially rare.

combined.description: A rare event and a reversed sensor occur together. This combination is absent from both training mixtures.

ambiguous.description: The prior and sensor reading exactly balance; the event probability is one half.
